last_note: Manual QA on real Docker Desktop surfaced two real issues fixed post-review (2026-08-15): (1) zookeeper healthcheck used `ruok`, which ZooKeeper 3.5+ blocks by default (fixed with ZOO_4LW_COMMANDS_WHITELIST, but made moot by #2); (2) bitnami/kafka:latest now tracks Kafka 4.0, which removed Zookeeper support entirely (KRaft-only) — the zookeeper service and KAFKA_CFG_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT were removed, kafka now runs standalone in KRaft mode (KAFKA_CFG_PROCESS_ROLES=controller,broker, single-node quorum). Ticket T004.md and QA checklist .claude/qa/T004.qa.md updated to match. Infra now: sqlserver, sqlserver-init, mongodb, kafka (KRaft), redis, kafka-ui — no zookeeper. All other original notes (per-service DB naming, COMPOSE_FILE wiring, no hardcoded secrets) still hold.
